authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Ordered components ek + jaisa: CDIAL 2462 subsection 2 *ekka explicitly gives Hindi and Gujarati ek one. CDIAL 10458 yādṛśa explicitly gives Prakrit jaïsa, Nepali jaso, Hindi jaisā, Old Marwari jaïsaü and Marathi jasā. Selected jaisa/jesa/jasa forms match this sort/likeness family; the survey same sense expresses equivalence. Regional vowels, affrication and the śy notation in jɛśyɔ remain qualified, not normalized. Local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Both components are represented while preserving the original spacing and inflection; no ancient compound is reconstructed. Exact response: ek jāīsɔ.
